+"""Vision-guided controller for the door-lock episode (eai-standard/2.1).
+
+Only camera images, the advertised target point, and robot proprioception are
+used. Each call advances the live episode; do not rerun a completed phase.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs/doorlock")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+CAMERAS = ["front", "left", "right", "topview"]
+
+
+def proprio_dict(meta):
+    p = meta["proprio"]
+    return dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+
+
+def go(robot, spec, target, grip=-1.0, max_step=0.002, note="move"):
+    """Move mocap target along a straight line with small native actions."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=False, video="frames")
+    p = proprio_dict(obs.meta)
+    start = np.array([p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], p["mocap_z"]])
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+    delta = target - start
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / max_step)))
+    step = delta / n
+    action = np.r_[step / 0.01, float(grip)]
+    a = np.repeat(action[None, :], n, axis=0)
+    # A chunk is limited to ten simulated seconds by the service.
+    dt = spec["control_dt"]
+    max_rows = int(10.0 / dt)
+    results = []
+    for offset in range(0, n, max_rows):
+        res = robot.submit("ee_delta", a[offset:offset + max_rows], dt=dt,
+                           cameras=CAMERAS, video="mp4", note=note)
+        path = OUT / f"{len(list(OUT.glob('*.json'))):03d}_{note.replace(' ', '_')}"
+        res.save(str(path))
+        results.append(res)
+        if res.done:
+            break
+    return results[-1]
+
+
+def run_initial_lift():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+    obs.save(str(OUT / "00_initial"))
+    p = proprio_dict(obs.meta)
+    # First clear the tabletop hardware while retaining the open gripper.
+    result = go(robot, spec, [p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], 0.28],
+                grip=-1.0, max_step=0.002, note="lift_clear")
+    result.save(str(OUT / "01_lift_clear"))
+    print(json.dumps({"meta": result.meta,
+                      "proprio": result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now")}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run_initial_lift()
